_readme: Feeds the 'Recent Changes' panel on the dashboard (WebDashboard/index.html). Add a new entry to the TOP of 'entries' for each published revision. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD, required), models (list of model names to display, e.g. ["AT-802", "AT-802A"]; the numbers 402 / 502 / 602 / 802 are expanded to the full model name; ["all"] shows 'All models'), text (what changed, written for owners, required), link (optional: a URL, or a path relative to this file, e.g. a change report PDF), linkLabel (optional text for the link, defaults to 'Change report'). Entries missing a date or text are skipped; the dashboard shows the 10 newest. Keep it valid JSON: double quotes, commas between entries, none after the last one.
